drafts.subject: Marketing after Cantina's raise
drafts.body_text:
Hi Hari,

Congratulations on Cantina's $8M raise and the move into agentic security. Widening from one product line to a platform is usually when positioning needs a hard look.

I build demand gen, positioning and marketing teams for cybersecurity companies, as a fractional CMO or full-time leader. I've done it at HYPR and Morphisec.

Would you be open to a short conversation about how Cantina plans to take the platform to market?

If this isn't relevant, reply "no thanks" and I won't follow up.

Christine Castro
